title: Liouville Energy Locates the Rightmost Zeta Zero: Lean 4 and Julia code
description: Lean 4 project (24 theorems over Mathlib, standard axioms only) and three Julia programs that check the finite identities and numerical constants of the paper "Liouville Energy Locates the Rightmost Zeta Zero" by D. Bhattacharjee and U. Bhattacharya: the energy identities and completion bounds for the sliding-window energy Q(N) of the Liouville function, explicit bounds for L(x) and the Mertens function, the pole-energy certificates, and the numerics for N up to 3·10^7. The archive contains code only; the paper is not included.
